indexes.name: idx_cost_active_payment_expense
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_cost_active_payment_expense ON app.expense_payments USING btree (expense_id) WHERE (retired_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: idx_cost_authority_user_scope
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_cost_authority_user_scope ON app.cost_financial_authorities USING btree (user_id, financial_scope_id)

indexes.name: idx_cost_record_scope
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_cost_record_scope ON app.cost_financial_records USING btree (financial_scope_id)

indexes.name: uq_active_cost_concept_name
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_active_cost_concept_name ON app.cost_concepts USING btree (financial_scope_id, lower(name)) WHERE ((status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (financial_scope_id IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: uq_active_cost_event_type_name
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_active_cost_event_type_name ON app.cost_event_types USING btree (financial_scope_id, lower(name)) WHERE ((status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (financial_scope_id IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: uq_cost_active_allocation_party
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_cost_active_allocation_party ON app.expense_allocations USING btree (expense_id, party_id) WHERE (retired_at IS NULL)

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_cost_allocation_open_detail BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON app.expense_allocations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.guard_cost_open_detail()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cost_payment_open_detail BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON app.expense_payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.guard_cost_open_detail()

constraints.name: ck_cost_concept_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(btrim(name)) > 0) AND (cost_class = ANY (ARRAY['FIXED'::text, 'VARIABLE'::text])) AND (default_allocation_method = ANY (ARRAY['OWNERSHIP'::text, 'CUSTOM'::text, 'UTILIZATION'::text, 'DIRECT'::text])) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['ACTIVE'::text, 'ARCHIVED'::text]))))

constraints.name: ck_cost_event_type_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(btrim(name)) > 0) AND (boundary_basis = ANY (ARRAY['NONE'::text, 'FLIGHT_TIME'::text, 'LANDINGS'::text, 'PRESSURIZATION_CYCLES'::text, 'ENGINE_CYCLES'::text])) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['ACTIVE'::text, 'ARCHIVED'::text])) AND (((boundary_basis = 'ENGINE_CYCLES'::text) AND (component_position IS NOT NULL) AND (component_position > 0)) OR ((boundary_basis <> 'ENGINE_CYCLES'::text) AND (component_position IS NULL)))))

constraints.name: ck_cost_event_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(btrim(title)) > 0) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::text, 'SETTLED'::text])) AND (((status = 'OPEN'::text) AND (settled_at IS NULL) AND (settled_by_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'SETTLED'::text) AND (settled_at IS NOT NULL) AND (settled_by_user_id IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.name: fk_cost_record_concept
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (cost_concept_id, aircraft_id, financial_scope_id) REFERENCES app.cost_concepts(cost_concept_id, aircraft_id, financial_scope_id)

constraints.name: fk_cost_record_event
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (cost_event_id, aircraft_id) REFERENCES app.cost_events(cost_event_id, aircraft_id)

constraints.name: fk_cost_record_expense
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (expense_id, aircraft_id) REFERENCES app.expenses(expense_id, aircraft_id)

constraints.name: fk_cost_record_settlement
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (cost_settlement_id, aircraft_id) REFERENCES app.cost_settlements(cost_settlement_id, aircraft_id)

constraints.name: fk_cost_record_type
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (cost_event_type_id, aircraft_id, financial_scope_id) REFERENCES app.cost_event_types(cost_event_type_id, aircraft_id, financial_scope_id)

constraints.name: ck_cost_settlement_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((currency_code ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(source_snapshot) = 'object'::text) AND (((cost_event_id IS NOT NULL) AND (period_start_date IS NULL) AND (period_end_date IS NULL)) OR ((cost_event_id IS NULL) AND (period_start_date IS NOT NULL) AND (period_end_date IS NOT NULL) AND (period_start_date <= period_end_date)))))

constraints.name: ck_cost_allocation_retirement
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((retired_at IS NULL) AND (retired_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (retired_correction_id IS NULL)) OR ((retired_at IS NOT NULL) AND (retired_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (retired_correction_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_cost_payment_retirement
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((retired_at IS NULL) AND (retired_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (retired_correction_id IS NULL)) OR ((retired_at IS NOT NULL) AND (retired_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (retired_correction_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_expense_utilization_metric
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((allocation_method = 'UTILIZATION'::text) AND (utilization_metric = ANY (ARRAY['FLIGHT_TIME'::text, 'LANDINGS'::text, 'PRESSURIZATION_CYCLES'::text, 'ENGINE_CYCLES'::text])) AND (((utilization_metric = 'ENGINE_CYCLES'::text) AND (utilization_component_position IS NOT NULL) AND (utilization_component_position > 0)) OR ((utilization_metric <> 'ENGINE_CYCLES'::text) AND (utilization_component_position IS NULL)))) OR ((allocation_method <> 'UTILIZATION'::text) AND (utilization_metric IS NULL) AND (utilization_component_position IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_expense_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((amount > (0)::numeric) AND (currency_code ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text) AND (allocation_method = ANY (ARRAY['OWNERSHIP'::text, 'CUSTOM'::text, 'UTILIZATION'::text, 'DIRECT'::text])) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::text, 'VOID'::text]))))
